candidate_decisions.reason: The change description and the head both keep retention_days under a moved name with an alias.

findings.summary: Output "queue_arn" indexes a conditional resource without try, so it fails when the queue is not created.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the value of `output "queue_arn"` in `modules/worker/outputs.tf` in `try(..., null)`.

findings.summary: Output "arn" indexes a conditional resource without try.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the value of `output "arn"` in `outputs.tf` in `try(..., null)`.

findings.summary: The IAM blocks are split around the queue resource.
findings.suggested_fix: Move `resource "aws_iam_role" "this"` in `main.tf` next to the other IAM blocks.
